name: Memory — hermes_remember + hermes_recall
mechanical_verification: Store a value, retrieve it, verify exact match
expected_behavior: Storage confirmation with topic and value echoed back

verification_steps.expected: Same value returned that was stored in step 1
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Retrieved value matches stored value exactly

pass_criteria.value_integrity: Stored value === retrieved value (exact string match)

failure_modes.retrieve_fails: hermes_recall returns empty or wrong value
failure_modes.value_mismatch: Retrieved value differs from stored value

spillover_check.description: Verify hermes_remember/recall only accessible to Hermes agents
spillover_check.test: As a vanilla agent (plan/build), try hermes_remember
spillover_check.expected: Tool should either be filtered out or return access-denied
